description: Phase 2 STT test set: read each line aloud, naturally, through the microphone AIRA will use. The text is the reference transcript (Tamil words in Tamil script, English words in Latin script). The 40 TTS sentences are reused, plus 10 typical commands.

prompts.text: Hey AIRA, what's happening with my laptop?
Hey AIRA, open Visual Studio Code.
Remind me to study Java at seven PM.
AIRA, இந்த Python error-ஐ explain பண்ணு.
